observation: The Association des Amis de l’Art de Marcel Dupré describes its 2015 Mercury restoration project. Page 2 lists Franck Pièce héroïque and three organ chorals as CD1, recorded in 1957 at Saint Thomas Church, New York City; source Mercury SR90168 notes the same organ/venue. The four selected Mercury tracks name Dupré as MainArtist independently of AssociatedPerformer and Franck as Composer. All four source works match in order.
limits: The association describes remastering from original tapes, not equality of the LP transfer with the digital mastering. Source has no track durations; exact pressing, take and transfer equality not verified.
